FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 217
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Mike Shaw
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/17/2025
House Bill 217 as introduced would decrease income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund
by an estimated $7.6 million annually by excluding difficulty of care payments under 26 U.S.C.
§131 from gross income beginning with tax year 2026.
